curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the extra skills test tasks and the waiting periods after failed attempts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on retest waits and how the days are counted.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items that ask how long to wait after each failure.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the deadlines and hand-ins when moving in or out of the state.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the switch deadline, exemptions, surrender and plate return.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario items on new residents, temporary residents and people moving away.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast visitors, international permits and reciprocity waivers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on visitors, the international permit and reciprocity.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on who may drive on an outside license and what the permit is.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the vision test, accepted certificates and the military exemption.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on screenings, certificate dates and military documents.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on certificate age limits and who skips screening.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Compare the three renewal channels and who may use each.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on online eligibility, mail contents and branch requirements.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items that test online renewal blocks and mail renewal timing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover expired licenses, how points are posted and halved, and the suspension thresholds.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the nine-month line and each point threshold.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items that separate teen and adult point limits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the defensive driving course rules and reinstatement help.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on course rules and timing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on when the course helps and when it cannot.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Lay out the three special licenses available during some suspensions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on eligibility, limits and costs of each special license.
